thesis: The episode introduces Giuseppe Paleologo, a quantitative researcher with experience at Citadel, Millennium, and HRT, who describes the role as providing central services to buy-side portfolio managers. These services include factor models, hedging, internal alpha capture, and portfolio management advisory to help managers understand performance and monetize ideas.
